notes: The strict token-F1 and independent official judge-protocol numbers are reported separately.
This is a single fresh live-provider draw over all 1540 non-adversarial questions with zero execution or judge failures.
The observed 0.4-0.7 percentage-point run-to-run spread is a heuristic provider-variance estimate, so this result is not attributed to the R6 retrieval change.
External headline scores use different model stacks and retrieval budgets and are references, not controlled head-to-head measurements.
